executive_summary: Collection window March 14-20, 2028: Paris Fashion Week Fall/Winter 2028 women's shows, which opened in the prior window per the 2028-03-13 report, concluded within this window, closing the international Fall/Winter 2028 women's fashion-month sequence across New York, London, Milan, and Paris. No individual house published a new runway lookbook with independent editorial corroboration this window, so no designer-intent silhouette signal cleared the corroboration bar. Instead, wwd.com and vogue.com each independently published a season-in-review piece synthesizing the runway lookbooks and reviews already logged across this fashion-month cycle, and both independently drew the same specific cross-house comparison: the raw, unfinished-cut hem construction on the 2028-03-13 Miu Miu slip skirt and the exposed-seam construction underlying the closed-out 2027-10-18 Margiela raw-edge thread, read together as a recognizable unfinished-edge construction idiom recurring across separate houses and design lineages this Fall/Winter 2028 season, rather than as two coincidentally similar one-off choices. This is retrospective editorial interpretation of runway output that has already occurred within this archive's tracked window -- not a forecast or prediction about a future season -- so precedent 14's forecast-exclusion reasoning does not apply; the two houses' actual shows are past events being interpreted, not speculative claims about what a future season will contain. It is nonetheless treated as a distinct category from the earlier designer-intent-stage signals themselves: this is the first editorial-interpretation-stage cross-house synthesis logged since the Miu Miu signal's human_editor_note flagged watching for exactly this pattern. Because both corroborating sources resolve to the same source_sector (editorial), per precedent 2 this is capped at 'medium' regardless of the fact that two separate outlets independently reached the same read -- volume within one sector does not substitute for cross-sector corroboration. This case is flagged as a candidate rather than assumed to cleanly match an existing precedent: no precedent in the discipline doc directly addresses a season-wrap piece that synthesizes multiple already-logged signals into a new cross-house interpretive claim, as distinct from a single-signal confidence question. A future agent revisiting this signal type should consider whether a dedicated precedent is warranted before this pattern recurs unreviewed. The Khaite cantilevered-shoulder-blazer, Proenza Schouler spiral-seam-wrap-coat, Simone Rocha pearl-trimmed puff-sleeve dress, Prada inverted-pleat cargo skirt, resort 2028 puffer-shell skirt, resale-demand, obi-sash cocoon coat, and opera-glove/'restraint dressing' threads all produced no new development this window and are not carried forward again absent fresh movement. The Margiela raw-edge thread itself remains closed out as of 2027-10-18 -- this window's synthesis cites it as a historical reference point in the editorial framing, not as a reopening of that thread. Met Gala 2027, Wales Bonner, and CFDA's Fashion Fund/Awards remain untracked going forward per standing convention.
